blocks.text: Electron microscope electrons ki lehar wali fitrat istemal karta hai, jin ki de Broglie wavelength nazar aane wali roshni ki wavelength se hazaron guna chhoti ho sakti hai. Is se yeh woh bareek tafseelat dikhata hai jo optical microscope nahi dikha sakta. Source se electrons condenser naam ke electromagnetic lens se guzarte hain jo shua ko specimen par focus karta hai. Shua megavolts tak pohanchne wale voltages se tez ki jati hai; electrons jitne tez, un ki wavelength utni chhoti aur resolution utni zyada. Electromagnetic objective lens specimen ki tasveer banata hai, jise electromagnetic projector lens mazeed bara karta aur us ki tasveer li jati hai; is tasveer ko micrograph kehte hain (Fig 18.8).

Jadeed scanning electron microscopes shandar mayaar ki teen-jehti tasaveer de sakte hain. Electron microscopes nanometre paimane tak, atomic satah ke qareeb, tafseelat dikha sakte hain. Yeh microbiology mein cell ki banawat, viruses aur bacteria ke mutale, dhaaton mein daraaron ki tehqeeq, aur materials aur crystal ki banawat ke mutale mein use hote hain.

blocks.alt: Amudi khaaka. Oopar electron source shua neeche magnetic condenser lens se patle specimen par bhejta; magnetic objective lens pehli tasveer banata, aur magnetic projector lens shua phaila kar neeche screen ya film par doosri, bari tasveer banata. Note samjhata ke unche voltages se tez kiye electrons ki de Broglie wavelength bohat chhoti hoti, is liye bareek tafseel dekhi ja sakti hai.
blocks.caption: Transmission electron microscope (Fig 18.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Yeh roshni ke projector ki tarah kaam karta hai, lekin sheeshe ke lenses ki jagah magnetic lenses electrons ki shua morte hain. Electron ki wavelength bohat chhoti hone se kaheen chhoti tafseelat nazar aati hain.

blocks.prompt: Electron microscope optical microscope se bareek tafseel kyun dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Resolution istemal hone wali wavelength se mehdood hai; tez electrons ki de Broglie wavelength nazar aane wali roshni se hazaron guna chhoti hai, is liye kaheen chhoti tafseelat alag dekhi ja sakti hain.

items: Electron microscope: bohat chhoti wavelength wali electron lehrein.
Magnetic condenser, objective aur projector lenses; tasveer micrograph.
